newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil ends lower, trims losses at close.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil ends lower, trims losses at close.

text.p: IPE gas oil ended lower after a bout of profit-taking bit deeply into this week's sharp gains, but trimmed its losses just before the close.
October gas oil ended down $3.00 a tonne at $228.75 a tonne, at the day's high, after dipping at one point to a low of $226.
Dealers said its late nudge up signalled the underlying strength of a market which hit five-year highs on Thursday.
They said prices were probably just taking a breather and few were prepared to rule out a further surge higher.
"We've seen a big move higher this week and it's only natural to see some profit-taking," said one IPE broker.
"But it would be a brave man who bet against it going up again. It could quite easily make new highs next week."
IPE Brent was steady at slightly lower levels, down eight cents by 1630 GMT at $22.85 a barrel.
Dealers said Brent had spent a quiet day, taking direction from gas oil and heating oil in the U.S., where profit-takers also were in operation on Friday.
